breakdown.description: The prompt sets the support slopes to zero under symmetric loading, but a simply supported beam under uniform load still rotates at the supports.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification explicitly states 'Use the simply supported boundary conditions v(0) = 0 and v(L) = 0 only' and 'Do not prescribe end slopes; treat θ(0) and θ(L) as unknowns determined by the solution.' This correctly removes the erroneous constraint that end slopes are zero, aligning with the ground truth which simply asks to determine the slope at x=0 rather than assuming it is zero. The agent correctly recognizes that a simply supported beam under UDL rotates at the supports.
